task_description: Transform CSVForge from a local FastAPI/PostgreSQL app into a distributed AWS system. Create real AWS resources (S3 bucket, SQS queue + DLQ) in ap-south-1, implement the S3 and SQS client wrappers, implement the CSV processing pipeline (parser + cleaner), add the FastAPI upload endpoints (presigned URL generation + upload confirmation), and implement the worker Lambda handler skeleton.
